none: PAS LIN-B2BC46: Drawing of a silver Roman finger ring inscribed TOT

A silver Roman finger ring, Henig Type XI, dating to the 2nd - 3rd century AD. The ring has a flat rectangular bezel with tapering shoulders and narrowed hoop. The bezel is decorated with a rectangle formed of incised diagonal hatching. within the rectangle are the inscribed letters ToT.
